limitations: Small synthetic/object-in-room corpus, not game traces. Catalog membership does not guarantee visible asset coverage; these examples are primitive-dominated.
Mean energy bias remains +1.0% procedural / +2.3% object scenes; residual specular noise and blotches remain.
Optimized training/evaluation use Meganeura's release default: Vulkan validation disabled. Debug numerical tests pass, but validation fails with VUID-StandaloneSpirv-None-10684.
No external-denoiser/DLSS or real-time performance claim.
